tags.feature: - Inclusion of page 5 of the instructions that speaks of the Status / Attributes screen;
- Reformulation and improvement of the "Special Attack";

notes.title: 0.82 3/13/2020 - Update of the game engine version
notes.content:
The following changes were made in this version:
- Update of the engine version, resulting in improved game performance and consistency of a large number of scripts;
- Change in the level crossing process. Before, it was necessary to click on the "Tab" button to call the cursor to confirm the level crossing. Now the user just needs to get close to the level crossing indicator, and the "status" screen is displayed.
- Several scripts and scenarios have been redone to meet the characteristics of the game engine update

notes.title: 0.81 10/11/2019 - Adjustments and corrections
notes.content:
Several tweaks and fixes made in version 0.81 of 11/11/2019.

- Module that saves the level has been redone. Some users have stated that depending on the game's exit sequence it was not saved at the corresponding level.
- New feature that identifies the minimum amount of leg to pass the level. It was not shown when moving from one level to another the minimum amount of leg to pass the level. An icon was inserted at the top of the screen, in the middle, identified by the BOB image and a star with the minimum amount of legs to be collected at the level in question.
- Redesigns the instruction screens with a "cleaner" font for better readability.
- Several internal adjustments for game optimization.
